name: Microgrid PCC export-limit controller
summary: Requests resource adjustments when measured export approaches the assigned connection limit.
description: Requests resource adjustments when measured export approaches the assigned connection limit. Active-power dispatch allocates the electrical work performed by the microgrid resources. A total site target, a resource power limit and the actual measured contribution are different quantities that must be connected clearly in the diagram.

In a microgrid with solar generation, a battery and generators, the controller can allocate an import/export target among the available resources while reserving the power needed for operating disturbances. For this reference, the drawing identifies “PCC export measurement and limit” at the input and “Export-control adjustment” at the output. Protection can provide a separate export-related function.
